svg.title: EDIT-14D Adjust proposed light and dark panel states
svg.desc: Two full-height 1080 by 2340 pixel design frames and paired scaled detail frames for Light, Curves, Mix, Spot and Auto, showing transaction actions, photo context, focus and touch annotations. Synthetic vector proposal only; not an Android screenshot.
svg.text: EDIT-14D · Adjust · proposed design evidence only
Main paired frames · 360 × 780 dp at ×3 = 1080 × 2340 px · proposed, not rendered Android evidence

DARK

g.text: Select RGB or one component channel
Select RGB or one component channel

svg.text: Focus: channel → selected point → Add / Remove → Cancel / Reset / Apply.
Point drag and add/remove remain staged. Every target ≥48 dp; at 200% channels scroll or wrap while graph, photo anchor and action row remain reachable.
Photo remains visible above the deck; no range or step is inferred (D).
LIGHT · MIX
DARK · MIX

Eyedropper samples from the visible photo

svg.text: Focus: eyedropper → three swatches → Hue → Saturation → Luminance → transaction actions.
Exactly three custom sample swatches; no fourth slot. Sampling uses the photo; slider drags remain staged.
At 200%, sample row and controls scroll vertically; photo anchor and ≥48 dp actions remain reachable.

svg.text: Focus: Add / Remove / Brush erase → bounded brush → Cancel / Reset / Apply.
Circle is the visible affected-area boundary; touch/drag stays within it. Brush dimensions remain D.
At 200%, mode chips wrap/scroll; photo context and ≥48 dp controls persist.

g.text: Suggestion is staged only after Accept
Accept stages; Apply commits one recipe step.
Dismiss preserves current preview and history.
Suggestion is staged only after Accept
Accept stages; Apply commits one recipe step.

svg.text: Auto is the first visible entry action. Accept stages; Dismiss preserves the current preview.
Apply commits one recipe step; Auto never commits by itself. At 200%, copy wraps and the photo remains visible.
Annotation key
* Save is the existing shared editor-shell command only. Cancel, Reset and Apply are distinct Adjust transaction actions. Dashed action outlines mark 48 dp logical targets.
All images and sample swatches are synthetic. Values are illustrative labels only; ranges, steps, brush dimensions and device geometry remain D pending engine/canary evidence.
